title: GATE-ST: Gene-Aware Text-image Encoder for Spatial Transcriptomics
abstract: arXiv:2609.38690v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Spatial transcriptomics enables spatially resolved gene expression analysis from slide-level images while preserving morphological features, providing valuable information for studying disease mechanisms and developing treatments. However, spatial gene expression profiling typically requires expensive and time-consuming tests. While existing image-based prediction optimizations mostly revolve around including positional embeddings and further image-based changes, text-based optimizations remain relatively unexplored. We present GATE-ST, which incorporates text-based inputs into image-based spatial gene expression predictions. With this approach, generated text descriptions of genes are utilized to better spatial transcriptomics prediction results. translated_title: GATE-ST：面向空间转录组学的基因感知文本-图像编码器
translated_abstract: 空间转录组学能够在保留形态特征的同时，从切片级图像中进行空间分辨的基因表达分析，为研究疾病机制和开发治疗方法提供了宝贵的信息。然而，空间基因表达谱分析通常需要昂贵且耗时的检测。现有的基于图像的预测优化大多围绕位置嵌入及进一步的图像改进展开，而基于文本的优化仍未得到充分探索。我们提出了GATE-ST，该方法将基于文本的输入融入基于图像的空间基因表达预测中。通过这种方法，利用生成的基因文本描述来改善空间转录组学的预测结果。基因摘要经过文本编码器处理，生成嵌入向量，并通过交叉注意力层与图像嵌入进行整合，以与形态特征对齐。我们展示了（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: GATE-ST创新性地将基因的文本描述编码后，通过交叉注意力层与图像嵌入融合，从而提升基于图像的空间转录组学基因表达预测性能。
en_tdlr: GATE-ST improves image-based spatial gene expression prediction by encoding gene text summaries and integrating them with image embeddings through cross-attention layers.
